Cabot Oil Gas (COG) Shareholder Weiss Multi-Strategy Advisers Has Cut Its Position as Market Valuation Declined; Perigon Wealth Management Has Boosted Apple (AAPL) Position by $1.08 Million
June 2, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Weiss Multi-Strategy Advisers Llc decreased its stake in Cabot Oil Gas (COG) by 47.79% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Weiss Multi-Strategy Advisers Llc sold 224,932 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.78% with the market. The hedge fund held 245,777 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.89M, down from 470,709 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Weiss Multi-Strategy Advisers Llc who had been investing in Cabot Oil Gas for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $10.40 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.79% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $23.03. About 4.05 million shares traded. Cabot Oil & Gas Corporation (NYSE:COG) has declined 1.53% since June 2, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.10% the S&P500.
Perigon Wealth Management Llc increased its stake in Apple (AAPL) by 8.01% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Perigon Wealth Management Llc bought 6,449 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 86,984 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $14.59 million, up from 80,535 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Perigon Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Apple for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $935.06B market cap company. The stock increased 1.80% or $3.37 during the last trading session, reaching $190.24. About 21.25 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
